subject.title: feat(ui): animated Clawd mascot on the new-session welcome hero

question: Should Control UI adopt this independent full mood-and-canvas mascot system now, or keep the welcome hero on the existing shared lobster renderer and add capabilities incrementally?
rationale: Both directions can be implemented correctly, but the permanent ownership, synchronization burden, and desired scope of cross-platform mascot parity require explicit product intent.

options.title: Narrow to shared renderer
options.body: Reuse the existing lobster renderer and add only the welcome animation behavior currently needed, avoiding a second mascot source of truth.

options.title: Adopt the full canvas system
options.body: Accept the parallel implementation only with an explicit owner and a concrete mechanism or tests that keep web geometry, palettes, and moods aligned with the canonical native assets.

options.title: Pause for shared asset design
options.body: Defer the feature until web and native mascot assets can be generated from or validated against one shared specification.

recommendation.title: Narrow to shared renderer
recommendation.body: Reuse the existing lobster renderer and add only the welcome animation behavior currently needed, avoiding a second mascot source of truth.

likelyOwner.reason: He is the project’s documented product owner and the best available owner for the intended mascot and brand architecture.
